/understand-myself.title: Understand myself
/understand-myself.lead: Read, listen, or explore a questionnaire.

sections.title: What you can explore
sections.text: EmTalk brings together nine articles about sleep and burnout, each with an audio version, and five questionnaire pages.

sections.title: Why start here?
sections.text: Start with a topic you want to understand. Reading and listening offer context; questionnaires give you a set of questions to reflect on.

sections.title: How to begin
sections.text: Choose Read articles to browse the articles and listen on their pages. Choose Explore tests to see the available questionnaires. You can return here and choose a different resource at any time.

/tapl.title: Tapl: small steps, a clearer way forward
/tapl.lead: Tapl is being developed to help you turn a goal into manageable actions, with a weekly plan you can review and adjust as life changes.

/dm/workspace.title: Decision Matrix guest workspace
/dm/workspace.lead: Compare up to eight options. With four or more, compare pairs first; with up to three, weigh pros and cons. Free to use, without an account.

/dm.title: Decision Matrix app and free comparison tool
/dm.lead: Explore the Decision Matrix app, or compare options in the free browser workspace. With four or more options, compare pairs first; with up to three, weigh pros and cons. No web account needed.

/bret.title: BRET breathing app and free web practice
/bret.lead: Explore the BRET breathing and relaxation app, or try its free browser practice: five breathing rhythms, custom timing and progressive muscle relaxation. No web account needed.

/bret/practice.title: Breathing timer and muscle relaxation
/bret/practice.lead: Use five breathing rhythms, including box breathing and 4-7-8, create a custom rhythm, or follow progressive muscle relaxation. Free to use, without an account.
